items.title: 入境處拘捕兩名男女 涉非法改動特區護照
items.summary: 有市民聲稱特區護照缺漏部份內頁，懷疑屬出廠瑕疵。入境處認為事件有可疑，調查後拘捕一男一女，涉嫌非法改動特區護照。兩人為情侶關係，早前同一時間前往外地及回港。 入境處表示，被捕女子在社交媒體聲稱特區護照缺頁，又說在外地遣返回港時，在機場有入境處人員指相關缺頁屬出廠瑕疵，星期三再親身前往入境處旅行證件組別，聲稱事件導致取消行程、損失旅費，其後當事人又改口，指缺頁情況並非由入境處人員說出。…
items.titleEn: Two men and two women arrested for illegally changing their passport
items.summaryEn: Some citizens claimed that the inside pages of the special passport were missing and suspected of being manufactured. After the investigation, a man and a woman were arrested on suspicion of illegally modifying a special passport. The couple had a sexual relationship and travelled abroad and back to the port at the same time. The arrivals said the woman was arrested on social media for allegedly missing a special passport page, and that while she was being repatriated to the port, the arrivals had pointed to the missing pages at the airport and the exit works, and on Wednesday returned to the arrival travel documents group, claiming that the incident led to cancellation of the trip, loss of travel costs, and subsequent change of language, indicating that the missing pages were not reported by the arrival staff. I'm not going to lie.

items.title: 政府：尊重市民心意 妥善處理宏福苑悼念花束
items.summary: 大埔宏福苑火災發生一年，不少市民自發前往宏福苑周邊獻花。 政府發言人表示，早前由於宏福苑現場鮮花數量眾多，考慮到傍晚可能有較多市民前往獻花，所以以膠箱暫時放置部分花束和物品，並移至鄰近草地，以騰出更多空間，方便市民繼續獻花表達心意，確保市民的每一份心意均得到尊重。…
items.titleEn: Government: Respect the will of the people, properly handle Hong Kong's memorial flowers
items.summaryEn: After a year of the Hong Kong Fire, many citizens volunteered to offer flowers around Hong Kong. A government spokesman said that early in the day, due to the large number of flowers on the grounds of the Hangzhou plantation and the possibility that more citizens would go to donate flowers in the evening, some of the flowers and items were temporarily placed in plastic containers and moved to the nearby grasslands to create more space for citizens to continue to give flowers to express their feelings and ensure that every opinion of citizens is respected. I'm not going to lie.

items.title: 旺角翠園大樓外牆圍網起火 55歲工人手腳燒傷送院治理
items.summary: 旺角登打士街翠園大樓發生火警，一名55歲工人手及小腿燒傷，清醒送往廣華醫院治理。 事發在下午5時許，警方接獲途人報案指大廈外牆圍網冒煙，消防到場將火救熄。經初步調查，相信一名工人於棚架工作期間意外燒傷，火花懷疑濺中圍網，現階段並無證據顯示案件涉及刑事成分。案件列「火警」及「有人意外受傷」。 消防處表示，火警成因相信是有工人在大廈外牆進行水喉工程時燒著雜物所致，現場沒有進行燒焊工程。 編輯：陳樂謙
items.titleEn: A 55-year-old worker's hands, feet and feet burned to the outside of the Hangzhou Garden building and sent to the administration of the park
items.summaryEn: A 55-year-old worker with a hand and a leg burned in a fire at the Whangdong Tsai Park building was taken to Guangzhou Government Hospital in critical condition. Police received a report of a smoke inhalation outside the building around 5 p.m., and firefighters arrived at the scene to save the fire. According to preliminary investigations, a worker was believed to have suffered accidental burns while working on a shelf, sparks suspected the net surrounding the shed, and there is no evidence at this stage to suggest that the case involved criminal elements. The case included "firefighters" and "someone was accidentally injured". According to the fire department, the fire department believes that some workers burned the garbage while working on the walls outside the building, but there was no burning on the site. Editors: Chen Li-Hum

items.title: 東華三院黃大仙醫院再多4人帶有耳念珠菌
items.summary: 東華三院黃大仙醫院一間護養病房，再多4名男病人帶有耳念珠菌，現正接受隔離治療，情況穩定。 院方表示，4名病人年齡介乎44歲至72歲，無出現感染病徵。防方繼續對病人的緊密接觸者展開追蹤篩查，已將有關個案呈報醫院管理局總辦事處及衞生署衞生防護中心作出跟進。 編輯：陳樂謙
items.titleEn: Four more people in Tōhō Three's Yellow Dragon Hospital with ear infections
items.summaryEn: A nursing home at the Yellow Dragon Hospital in Tokugawa, Tokugawa Prefecture, and four other male patients with ear infections are currently undergoing isolation treatment, and their condition is stable. According to the hospital, four patients, aged between 44 and 72, showed no signs of infection. The defence continues to pursue investigations into close contacts with patients and has reported the case to the General Office of the Hospital Administration and the Centers for Disease Control and Prevention (CDC). Editors: Chen Li-Hum

items.titleEn: Chinese and Hong Kong trade delegations visit Thailand to create a "one-stop shop" opportunity
items.summaryEn: The Hong Kong-based trade delegation, organized by the Hong Kong-China Business Delegation and the Hong Kong Business Delegations, will visit Thailand from 23rd to today, where its delegation members will meet with Thai government officials and business community to discuss new opportunities for green and digital cooperation, and witness the signing of three memoranda of cooperation by Hong Kong companies and agencies with Thai partners. items.title: 宏福苑火災一周年 入夜後繼續有市民到場獻花悼念
items.summary: 大埔宏福苑火災發生一年，入夜後繼續有市民到廣福社區會堂旁邊的空地獻花悼念，現場有市民情緒激動，社工在旁協助。 警方傳媒聯絡隊表示，估計會有更多人到場悼念，預計花束會越來越多，由於需要騰出更多空間放置花束，因此需要將花束轉移至另一處空地，強調會尊重悼念活動，不會丟棄花束，之後會將花束送至粉嶺蓬瀛仙館。 有牧師表示，宏福苑火災是每個香港人都不希望見到，他亦有朋友的親人於火災中離世，建議政府可以增設更多獻花地方。…
items.titleEn: After the first anniversary of the Hong Kong fire, the city's residents continued to gather to pay their respects.
items.summaryEn: After a year of devastating wildfires in Hong Kong, people continued to gather in the middle of the night to pay their respects to the empty flower garden next to Guangzhou's community hall, where there was a lot of public excitement and social workers were there to help. According to police media contacts, it is estimated that more people will attend the memorial, and it is expected that more and more flowers will be sent to the Puma Garden, where they will be sent, as more space will be needed to place the flowers, so that the flowers will need to be moved to another empty place, emphasizing that the ceremony will be respected and the flowers won't be thrown away. One pastor said that Hong Kong's Hong Kong Fire is something that not everyone wants to see, and that relatives of his friends died in the fire, suggesting that the government add more places to donate flowers. I'm not going to lie.

items.title: 海關機場檢獲約160萬元懷疑大麻花 一名內地男子被捕
items.summary: 海關在機場偵破一宗販毒案件，檢獲約7.3公斤懷疑大麻花，估計市值約160萬元，拘捕一名23歲內地男子。 該名男子從泰國曼谷抵港，海關人員在他的隨身行李檢獲該批懷疑大麻花，於是將他拘捕，並控以一項販運危險藥物罪。案件將於明日在西九龍裁判法院提堂。 編輯：陳樂謙
items.titleEn: A man in the country was arrested for suspecting marijuana at a customs airport for about 1.6 million yuan
items.summaryEn: Customs detected a drug trafficking case at the airport, seized about 7.3 kilograms of suspected marijuana, estimated to be worth about 1.6 million yuan, and arrested a 23-year-old inland man. After arriving at the port from Bangkok, Thailand, the man was arrested and charged with one count of dangerous drug trafficking after customs officers found the suspected marijuana baggage in his luggage. The case will be heard tomorrow in the West Bengal Magistrate's Court. Editors: Chen Li-Hum

items.title: 網約車駕駛許可證下周一起接受申請
items.summary: 運輸署公布，下周一早上10時起，接受網約車駕駛許可證申請，不設名額上限。 至於網約車車輛許可證，則計劃於明年初公開邀請申請，數目上限一萬個，超額會以抽籤形式分配。 編輯：梁家奇
items.titleEn: Applications for online driver's licenses will be accepted next week
items.summaryEn: The Department of Transportation announced that starting at 10 a.m. on Monday, the application for a license to drive a motor vehicle online will be accepted without a name limit. As for the online vehicle license, it is planned that the number of applications will be open to the public at the beginning of next year, up to a maximum of 10,000 and the surplus will be distributed by lottery. Editor's note: Liang Jian
